title: Playground and site performance/resilience
note: Budgets were derived after the first baseline run and before the acceptance run. They are regression-detection limits from this sandbox class, not product performance promises or self-approval. Missing metrics are skipped rather than assigned invented limits.

budgetMethod.time: ceil(max(2 x baseline p95, 1.25 x baseline max)) milliseconds
budgetMethod.longTask: ceil(2 x baseline maximum), with the browser 50 ms long-task threshold as the floor when the baseline saw no long task
budgetMethod.memory: ceil to MiB of max(0, baseline maximum delta) + 3 x baseline range + 1 MiB measurement floor
budgetMethod.size: baseline maximum bytes for a deterministic build at the same commit; acceptance must not exceed it
budgetMethod.counts: baseline maximum; exact behavioural counts are additionally asserted by the harness

coverage.heap: Chromium CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage; Firefox/WebKit do not expose an equivalent heap API and are not claimed
coverage.longTasks: Chromium PerformanceObserver longtask; other engines are measured for load/render time only
coverage.throttling: Chromium CDP network and CPU emulation only
coverage.browsers: Playwright Linux Chromium, Firefox and WebKit plus Pixel 7 mobile Chromium emulation; WebKit is not native Safari
